title: 2020 roadmap on pore materials for energy and environmental applications
claim: Thermal conversion of MOFs can produce porous catalyst components whose exposed sites and semiconductor heterojunctions are useful in photoelectrochemistry.
explanation: The review describes MOF-derived porous oxides, sulfides, carbides, and metal-site-containing materials as possible ways to increase accessible active centers and aid charge separation.
conditions: Conversion involves high-temperature processing and subsequent integration with the photoelectrode where relevant.
caveats: The review does not establish that every converted framework retains useful porosity or improves charge separation.
